extracted.name: Pepper Jelly Glazed Chicken
extracted.description: These oven-roasted chicken breasts are glazed with pepper jelly, honey, and Dijon mustard for a delicious, no-fuss 4-ingredient weeknight dinner.
ingredient_lines: 4 bone-in chicken breast halves, with skin
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees F).
Arrange chicken breasts in a large baking dish; do not overcrowd.
Mix together pepper jelly, mustard, and honey in a small bowl until well combined; pour over chicken to coat.

Bake uncovered in the preheated oven, basting occasionally, until chicken is no longer pink and the juices run clear, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
